title: Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers — Summit Flyer Rate on the Telephone Fee
content:
**Summit benefit term.** The telephone-fee member rate on a credit of Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers follows the customer's Summit tier in the Crestline Summit Loyalty Program and the flight accruals posted to the Summit account. The rate is **0.50** for a Summit Gold member with at least 3 flight accruals posted to the Summit account in the last 6 calendar months. It is **0.75** for a Summit Silver member with at least 3 such flight accruals, and **1** for every other customer.

**Window.** A telephone-fee window of the last so many calendar months holds the entries dated fewer than that many whole calendar months before the date the telephone fee is booked, so it rolls back from that date and is not a count of completed calendar months.

## Combinations

| Summit tier | Flight accruals in the last 6 calendar months | Member rate |
|---|---|---|
| Summit Gold | 3 or more | 0.50 |
| Summit Gold | 2 or fewer | 1 |
| Summit Silver | 3 or more | 0.75 |
| Summit Silver | 2 or fewer | 1 |
| any other tier, or no Summit membership | any number | 1 |

## Window boundary (hypothetical, fee booked on 15 October 2026)

- A flight accrual posted on 16 April 2026 is 5 whole calendar months back and counts.
- One posted on 15 April 2026 is 6 whole calendar months back and does not count.

A Summit Silver member with flight accruals on 16 April, 2 July and 30 September 2026 has 3 in the window, so the rate is 0.75. If the first of them had been posted on 15 April 2026, only 2 would count, and the rate would be 1.
